title: Akshita  (1)
transcript:
Akshita Sood: Hello everyone, my name is Akshita Sood and I am from Agra, Uttar Pradesh. I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering with a specialization in Cloud Computing and Automation from VIT Bhopal. I am in my pre-final year. 

Talking about my skills, I have a good understanding of Data Structures and Algorithms in C++ and I have experience in front-end development where I build clean and user-friendly interfaces. I am also interested in Python, especially for automation and AI-based applications. 

I have worked on projects like Generative AI-based coding agent, an interview mock system, and a front-end based medical website called MediDoc, which provides healthcare information along with an AI assistant. 

In terms of certifications, I have completed an NPTEL course in Internet of Things with a score of 97% and I was among the top 1% learners. I have also completed Google IT Certificate and Applied Machine Learning in Python Certificate from the University of Michigan. 

Apart from academics, my hobbies include reading books and trying new recipes. I am a quick learner, adaptable, and always interested in learning new technologies, especially in cloud, AI, and automation. Thank you.
summary: Akshita Sood delivered a self-introduction detailing her academic background as a pre-final year B.Tech Computer Science student specializing in Cloud Computing and Automation at VIT Bhopal. She outlined her technical expertise in C++ DSA, front-end development, and Python, alongside key projects in Generative AI and healthcare. She also shared her notable certifications, personal hobbies, and enthusiasm for cloud and AI technologies.
keyPoints: Akshita Sood is a pre-final year B.Tech CSE student specializing in Cloud Computing and Automation at VIT Bhopal.
Technical skill set includes Data Structures and Algorithms in C++, front-end development, and Python for AI and automation.
Worked on projects such as a Generative AI-based coding agent, an interview mock system, and MediDoc (a medical website with an AI assistant).
Certifications include NPTEL Internet of Things (97% score, top 1%), Google IT Certificate, and Applied Machine Learning in Python from the University of Michigan.
Personal hobbies include reading books and trying new recipes.
